chunks.text:
INEC Continuous Voter Registration Portal: Status Notice

INEC Portal
Welcome!
The Continuous Voter Registration (CVR) exercise has ended. Thank you for your participation.
Please expect an email notification once administrative processes are completed, and follow the
INEC Website
for official updates. As a Registered Voter, you can still check the status of your PVC and find your collection centre.
Get Started
Previous
Next
Voter Registration Status
×
To continue, please answer the question below:
Are you a registered voter?
No
Yes. Find My PVC
Voter Registration Status
×
The Continuous Voters Registration (CVR) exercise process is not currently active.
The Commission periodically conducts these registration exercises to ensure every eligible citizen has the opportunity to register and vote.
You can stay ahead and be among the first to know when the CVR exercise begins and to also receive timely updates.
Do you want to be notified when there are new updates?
No
Yes, Notify Me
